scripts.dev: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.build.json && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,web "tsx watch apps/server/src/index.ts" "vite apps/web --config apps/web/vite.config.ts"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.build.json && vite build apps/web --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
